<div class="dnaprs-closing-card">
<p>A passed preparation result means that the declared input was converted into a non-empty PGEN dataset. For raw arrays, marker decisions record source-probe selection, rsID assignment, TOP-strand recovery, and GRCh37 orientation. Ancestry, imputation quality, and participant eligibility remain downstream checks.</p>
</div>
